items.title: Approve the reply to Work Agency
items.why: A Rio model agency asked how many models you want and what profile. They are waiting on you to send options and days.
items.next_step: Open Approvals, read the Work Agency reply, tap Approve or deny with a note.

items.title: Approve the reply to Base Management
items.why: They asked if it is TFP, how many models, and which dates. No answer means no models booked.
items.next_step: Open Approvals and decide the Base Management reply.

items.title: Approve the reply to Genea Bailey (Noctis)
items.why: Noctis wants to see final images before deciding on publication. The reply promises finals.
items.next_step: Open Approvals and approve the Genea Bailey reply.

items.title: Approve the reply to Mafê Domingues
items.why: Covers São Paulo dates 24 to 30 November, budget and the magazine line. Expires 12 November.
items.next_step: Open Approvals, check the dates and magazine wording, then decide.

items.title: Approve the reply to Giovanna
items.why: She asked date, location, role and budget. The 'how you found her' question was left for you to answer.
items.next_step: Open Approvals and read the Giovanna reply; add how you found her if you want it in.

items.title: Decide the hotels and venues outreach (85 contacts)
items.why: Approving sends the email to all 85 hotels, restaurants and venues, starting with Grupo Arpoador. Nothing goes out until you decide.
items.next_step: Open Approvals and read the hotels and venues sample email.

items.title: Pick the final images to send Noctis
items.why: Once the Genea reply goes out, they expect finals. Publication depends on what they see.
items.next_step: Open the shoot folder and star the frames you would send.

items.title: Decide the $3/day 'dating ideas' Meta test
items.why: Four test ads are ready and waiting on your yes. It spends $3 a day with no end date once on.
items.next_step: Open Approvals and approve or deny the 'dating ideas - test' spend.

items.title: OK the vinyl-jacket photo fix going live
items.why: The trimmed photo-strip fix for the homepage has been waiting on your OK since 6 November.
items.next_step: Open the 'Portfolio website update for Rio' session and reply yes or no.

items.title: Get the sideways photo on /picks redeployed
items.why: The rotation bug is fixed in the tool but the live page still shows one pick sideways.
items.next_step: Open the 'Mac Anki app' session and tell it to redeploy /picks.
